posts.title: Who Can Do It?
posts.subtitle: can / can't

questions.q: Zippy is a robot. He has got rockets. He ___ fly.
questions.why: Roketleri var, yani uçabilir: can fly.
Olumsuz kısa cevap: No, she can't.
can'den sonra fiil yalın gelir: can run.

questions.q: Bubbles is a fish. “I can ___, but I can't walk.”
Tiko the turtle is very slow. Tiko can't ___ fast.
questions.why: Yavaş olan kaplumbağa hızlı koşamaz: can't run fast.

posts.title: Healthy Habits Quiz
posts.subtitle: should · frequency · healthy habits

questions.q:
Emre feels tired every morning because he goes to bed at 1 a.m.
What is the best advice for him?
o: He should go to bed earlier.
He should play games at night.
questions.why: Yorgunluğun sebebi geç yatmak; en iyi tavsiye erken yatmak.

questions.q: “I ___ eat fast food. Maybe once a year.”

Selin walks for 30 minutes, drinks a lot of water and sleeps 8 hours every day.
What can we say about Selin?
o: She takes care of her health.
questions.why: Yürüyüş, su ve düzenli uyku: sağlığına dikkat ediyor.

questions.q: “When I feel stressed, I ___ to music. It helps me relax.”
Which one is a healthy habit?
o: spending all day on the phone
questions.why: Meyve ve sebze yemek sağlıklı bir alışkanlıktır.

posts.title: Mind & Body Quiz
posts.subtitle: modals · phrasal verbs · vocabulary

questions.q: If you feel overwhelmed by exams, you ___ take short breaks while studying; otherwise, you may burn out.
questions.why: Tavsiye: had better + V1 (take). Diğerleri anlamca uymuyor.

questions.q: Regular exercise can ___ your mood and reduce anxiety.
questions.why: boost your mood = ruh halini yükseltmek.

questions.q: I've been trying to ___ sugar for a month, and I feel much more energetic.

A: I can't sleep well before exams.
B: ___ Maybe you should try a breathing exercise.
o: Never mind, it was my fault.
questions.why: Bir sıkıntıya empatiyle karşılık: That sounds really tough.

questions.q:
“Well-being is not only about physical health. It also includes how we manage our emotions, build relationships and find meaning in daily life.”
According to the text, well-being ___ .
questions.why: Metin duyguları ve ilişkileri de kapsadığını söylüyor.
